title: Contract-event records (0x0008) version 9: ballot version 4, version-2 delivery records and AuthorPanelRegistered
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/contract-event-v9-vectors.py: an independent Python implementation of docs/spec/contracts.md (Contract-event record, Event tables (version 9)) over contract-event-v8-vectors.py's version-8 check, delivery-batch-v2-vectors.py's version-2 batch and root decoders and author-ceremony-vectors.py's panels and approvals; ballots from ballot.json, ballot-v4-records.json and ballot-v5-records.json, delivery records from delivery.json, delivery-batch.json, delivery-root.json, delivery-v2.json and delivery-batch-v2.json, and every record of contract-event-v8.json and every board failure of contract-event-v2.json to contract-event-v5.json re-checked
